body.name: \(P_{\mathrm{ex}}\)
body.construction: Set \(p=2\), \(m=3\), and \(M=\{1,2,3\}\). Let \((\varepsilon_1^{(a)})_{a\in M}\) and \((\varepsilon_2^{(a)})_{a\in M}\) be independent centered Gaussian vectors with covariance matrices \(\Gamma_1=\begin{pmatrix}1&1/5&1/5\\1/5&1&1/5\\1/5&1/5&1\end{pmatrix}\) and \(\Gamma_2=\begin{pmatrix}1&1/5&2/5\\1/5&1&1/5\\2/5&1/5&1\end{pmatrix}\), respectively. For each \(a\in M\), set \(X_1^{(a)}=\varepsilon_1^{(a)}\) and \(X_2^{(a)}=X_1^{(a)}+\varepsilon_2^{(a)}\), and let \(P_{\mathrm{ex}}\) be the resulting law. Thus \(B^{0,(a)}=\begin{pmatrix}0&0\\1&0\end{pmatrix}\) and \(\Sigma^{aa}=\begin{pmatrix}1&1\\1&2\end{pmatrix}\) in every view.
